source_snapshot.procedure: Read `ipmitool sdr elist` and `ipmitool sensor list`, observe a temperature sensor increasing/decreasing and its configured thresholds, then `Try to full the SEL` and check SEL when the sensor reaches threshold; source clears logs first.
source_snapshot.criteria: Temperature changes normally, SDR type/settings and warning/critical thresholds match SPEC, and SEL contains a log when the sensor reaches threshold.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES supplies only static reads with unsafe SSH credential/host-key handling and cannot exercise the thermal event, full capacity, SEL retention or recovery.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: BLOCKED correctly rejects uncontrolled heating and filling, but leaves a binary purpose choice. The source name and steps can instead be preserved as an explicit near-full/final-entry/full-overflow matrix without guessing OEM behavior.

old_problem: The historical review retained Pending, Source Conflict and BLOCKED because `RealErr`, temperature stimulus and `Try to full the SEL` did not select among a real threshold test, injection or capacity test. Direct source review shows the safe non-regressive interpretation is a combined real-thermal and capacity-boundary case: prove assert/deassert normally, make the same event the final accepted near-full record, then verify the documented full/overflow result. Standard SEL and sensor mechanics are authoritative; target values, fixture and platform overflow policy are Project inputs.
disposition_reason: Preserve every source checkpoint and remove the false choice. On a dedicated log-isolated DUT, first prove one mapped real temperature sensor's assert/deassert with the SEL not full. Next add uniquely tagged synthetic capacity records by an approved standard/vendor path until exactly one target-event record remains available; trigger the same real event so it becomes the last accepted record and the SEL reaches full. After re-arm, trigger once at full and compare record retention/drop plus overflow flag with the approved platform policy. Export before every mutation, require point-of-action approval, use an attended real stimulus, and clean only tagged test records or an explicitly disposable SEL after evidence.
decision_basis: XLSX rows 764 and 765, duplicate-code row 1486, exact same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest and historical V3.1 record were directly read. Formal queue reconstruction identifies row 798 / variant a8489536e42f6246 as the next missing case because queue sequence 15 was already reviewed.

The duplicate code Wistron-BMC-00054-V003 at row 1486 is CPU Information Check / variant 1033d72510388fd9 and cannot supply or replace this row's thermal/SEL coverage; Source Key, row hash and variant remain explicit.

IPMI v2.0 section 31.2 defines mandatory Get SEL Info: version 51h, entry count, free bytes, most-recent add/erase timestamps and Operation Support. Bit 7 is the overflow flag and means events were dropped for lack of SEL space.

Sections 31.4-31.9 define reservation cancellation, full 16-byte Get/Add records, optional per-record delete and destructive Clear SEL. Add SEL Entry returns the generated Record ID; deletion/clear requires preservation and fresh reservation handling.

Sections 35.7, 35.9, 35.13 and 35.14 plus the Full Sensor Record define hysteresis, readable thresholds, event status, current reading/state and assertion/deassertion masks. The platform SDR supplies target-specific units, conversion and event map.

A synthetic Add SEL Entry proves storage boundary only and is never accepted as the real sensor event. `RealErr` retains an attended real physical/fixture-controlled threshold crossing; injection is not silently substituted.

ED-02, ED-03, ED-09, ED-13, ED-15, ED-17, ED-19, ED-20, ED-22, ED-26 through ED-30 and ED-33 through ED-38 preserve duplicate identity and full dynamic coverage, require evidence/threshold/SEL protection, allow bounded parameters and prohibit destructive shortcuts or blind retry.

test_case.test_name: Real temperature threshold event at normal, near-full and full SEL capacity
test_case.purpose: Verify one approved physical temperature sensor's real assert/deassert behavior, SDR type and thresholds, prove its event can become the final accepted record at the SEL capacity boundary, then verify the platform-approved full/overflow behavior for a subsequent real event without losing unrelated diagnostic evidence or leaving unsafe thermal/log state.
required_package: Dedicated non-production DUT/BMC whose SEL contains no valuable history, immutable target mapping, firmware/SDR package, protected ipmitool and validated source script revision; row 1486 is explicitly excluded

Project sensor contract: stable owner/LUN/number/ID, Full Sensor Record, units/conversion, SDR type, event/reading type, readable thresholds, positive/negative hysteresis, assert/deassert masks, exact SEL generator/sensor/event-data mapping and timestamp tolerance

Attended vendor-approved real thermal fixture or workload/environment method with ramp rate, dwell, warning/critical ceiling, cooldown/re-arm point, independent calibrated temperature, fan/power/host/BMC monitors, aborts and recovery owner; no unapproved sensor override

Versioned SEL capacity/overflow contract: usable bytes/allocation units, record size, near-full target, expected final-entry behavior, expected subsequent drop/retention and overflow flag, SEL Full/Almost Full events, wrap/overwrite policy and concurrency exclusion

Approved uniquely tagged synthetic fill-record generator using standard Add SEL Entry only where supported or a documented vendor method; exact generated Record IDs, batch bound and stop-before-target-space calculator

Evidence-first cleanup plan using per-record deletion when supported or separately confirmed Clear SEL only on the dedicated disposable log set; existing event history is never claimed restorable after clear
test_case.test_command: AUTHORIZED ATTENDED HYBRID PROCEDURE ONLY; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Verify the dedicated target and export/hash every SEL record plus Get SEL Info/allocation, SDR, thresholds, hysteresis, event-enable/status, sensor reading and independent health. Preserve logs; do not clear. Checkpoint A: after displaying the target, thresholds, thermal envelope and recovery, obtain immediate approval; the operator applies one bounded real temperature excursion across exactly the approved threshold while automation samples synchronized sensor/fixture/health and SEL. Require the mapped assert, safe cooldown below the hysteresis re-arm point and mapped deassert. Checkpoint B: after another full export and separate approval, add only uniquely tagged synthetic capacity records in precomputed bounded batches, recording every returned Record ID and re-reading capacity once per batch; stop with exactly enough supported space for one target event. Repeat the real excursion once; require the target event as the final accepted record, expected entry/free-space transition and no unrelated loss. Checkpoint C: export/hash again, re-arm/cool, obtain separate approval, trigger the same real event once while full, and compare event presence/drop, overflow bit and any SEL Full/Almost Full indication with the versioned platform policy; never infer a universal wrap rule. Export all final evidence before cleanup. Reacquire reservations as required and delete only tagged generated/test records when supported; otherwise clear only under an additional displayed confirmation on the disposable SEL, then verify empty/expected SEL, thermal recovery, BMC/host health and retained evidence. Never change thresholds, use injection as real-event evidence, clear before export, exceed aborts or retry any ambiguous stimulus/add/delete/clear.
test_case.expected_result: At normal capacity, the approved real sensor crosses the exact threshold with coherent converted reading, event status and one correctly mapped assert, then cools through hysteresis with the expected deassert. At near-full, the repeated real event is the last accepted SEL record and produces the approved full boundary state without unrelated record loss. At full, the subsequent event outcome and overflow/Full indications exactly match the platform policy; if dropped, Get SEL Info overflow is asserted and no false record is claimed. All synthetic records remain distinguishable, all preexisting evidence was exported first, cleanup follows supported operations, and DUT/BMC/thermal health returns to baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires all three checkpoints, exact Source Key/variant, authoritative sensor and capacity contracts, complete pre-mutation exports, immediate approvals, a real attended stimulus, threshold/hysteresis/readback agreement, mapped assert/deassert records, exact near-full calculation, target event as final accepted record, documented full-state outcome/overflow, no unrelated evidence loss, successful bounded cleanup and final health. Static `sdr`/sensor output, synthetic event as RealErr, guessed threshold, missing deassert, generic `Try to full`, unexpected overwrite/drop, absent required target log, overflow mismatch, clear without export/approval, untracked record IDs, retry or incomplete recovery cannot pass. Missing runtime package is NOT READY; N/A requires platform SPEC proof.
safety_gate: Use only a dedicated, log-isolated system. Export and hash complete SEL plus related BMC/host logs before every fill/delete/clear stage; never clear production diagnostic history.

Require separate point-of-action confirmation for real stimulus, capacity fill, full-state event and any cleanup clear, each showing current temperature/health, free space, planned records, aborts and recovery.

A trained operator/fixture performs physical thermal action. Automation only coordinates bounded monitoring and approved SEL operations; no threshold change, uncontrolled load/heat/cool or sensor injection substitution.

Stop immediately on critical/non-recoverable threshold, fixture/telemetry loss, fan/power anomaly, throttle/shutdown, unexpected record loss/wrap, BMC instability, wrong sensor/event mapping or uncertain add/delete/clear completion.
No automatic retry. After any ambiguous state, preserve first evidence and let the thermal/BMC owner choose recovery; do not add more records or repeat the event.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant, target/firmware/SDR/tool/script identity, sensor Full Record and decoded type/units/conversion/threshold/hysteresis/event masks/map
Complete hashed SEL exports and Get SEL Info/allocation/operation-support snapshots before mutation, after each checkpoint and before cleanup
Approval records plus calibrated fixture/temperature/fan/power/host/BMC trace synchronized with raw readings, event status and threshold crossings
Checkpoint-A assert/deassert records and hysteresis correlation; checkpoint-B fill Record IDs, batch capacity arithmetic and final accepted real event
Checkpoint-C full-state event presence/drop, overflow/SEL Full indicators and exact platform-policy comparison
Tagged-record deletion or separately approved disposable-log clear evidence, final SEL/thermal/system health, retained evidence hashes, coverage statement and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On thermal anomaly, stop the fixture/workload, restore approved cooling/environment, preserve readings/events and follow the platform shutdown/recovery owner; do not repeat. On unexpected SEL behavior or uncertain add/delete/clear, issue no further mutation, export what remains through an independent path and reconcile Record IDs/capacity with the BMC owner. Delete only confirmed tagged test records with fresh reservations if supported. If the only cleanup is full Clear SEL, perform it only after evidence preservation and a new confirmation on the dedicated disposable log set; never claim erased historical records were restored.

source_conflict.reason: The Review layer resolves rather than chooses among the source phrases: normal real threshold coverage, near-full final-entry coverage and full-state overflow coverage are separate mandatory checkpoints. The unrelated duplicate-code CPU row remains excluded by Source Key/Variant.

external_authorities.application: Sections 31.2-31.9 define SEL info/allocation/reservation/get/add/delete/clear, overflow and record behavior; sections 35.7, 35.9, 35.13-35.14 and Full Sensor Records define hysteresis, thresholds, readings/status and event masks.

project_authority: The Project thermal, platform and BMC owners approve the real stimulus, exact sensor/event oracle, SEL boundary/overflow policy, disposable evidence domain and cleanup. They operate/supervise physical action and issue the verdict; approval cannot turn static reads, synthetic fill events, lost history, an unverified clear or a missing real threshold record into PASS.
